rendered.body:
Hi Supergoop! team,

We’re a small team dedicated to crafting engaging Instagram content that brings health and wellness to the masses. We’d like to propose a collaborative post built around your team's recent accomplishments, specifically your use of AI and personalized shopping experiences. You’ve described Supergoop!’s partnership with Envive AI and its goal-oriented AI agent, which you've also cited in a published article about Supergoop!. This AI agent allows for a truly personalized shopper journey, and we believe a collaborative post that highlights this would resonate well with your audience. The post would feature a visually appealing slide showcasing your team's design and a call to action to explore the AI agent further. It would build on the idea of a shared experience and a personalized journey, where you both bring a unique perspective to the post.

The BrandPilot team
